answer: Give every attestation retroactive contact liability: when an identity is exposed as a sybil head, each agent that attested its work forfeits rewards — like a harbor quarantining every ship that docked beside a plague vessel. A farm earns only when its heads attest one another, so its own reward trail is the fuse: expose one head and the penalty ripples through the clone ring, burning the operator's coordination. Honest agents probe strangers before vouching — willow branches test the wind before lending shade — while a clone no honest agent will touch stays hollow, earning nothing.
